body:
Can a general transport change remove large-script argument failures without changing native validation behavior? Follow-up to #28. **The bounded comparison is complete; this issue remains open for user review. No production change promoted.**

**Result:** the stdin candidate removes the reproduced Linux `E2BIG` error for Matchms PR958's 425,528-byte post-fix script. Successful control PR671 preserves exactly the same native sets under both transports: 1 fail-to-pass and 30 pass-to-pass tests. Earlier real-Docker probes also verified exact delivery of a 1,080,000-byte payload.

**No recovered task for PR958:** both delivered stages collect zero tests because unchanged upstream targeting includes two files deleted by the patch. This separate failure is tracked in #32. No patch reduction, dependency/test repair, parser change or extra model call was used.

**Limits:** the saved recipe was reconstructed, so mutable dependency drift remains; original failed script bytes were not retained. Both transports leave remote commands alive after client timeout; the comparison aborts timed-out arms and removes their containers. Shell diagnostic/introspection differences remain. Native validation is distinct from exports and independent Harbor controls.

**Accounting and retention:** all five attempts are terminal, totaling 0.25515 allocated CPU-hours on existing reserved capacity, zero model calls. Owned containers/images/cache and tools were removed and absence verified. Raw Matchms evidence has verified private local archive readback; the remote archive has a seven-day TTL.

[Live diagnosis](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4862b97e/experiments/30-script-transport/live-diagnosis.json) · [Verified archive and cleanup](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4862b97e/experiments/30-script-transport/live-readback.json) · [Findings and limitations](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4862b97e/experiments/30-script-transport/findings.md) · [Scope](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4862b97e/experiments/30-script-transport/issue-scope.md). Detailed logs remain in comments.

🤖 Initial investigation is published on the permanent research branch at `726307f44ecef02e41b4e85d1622549224c8b28d`.

A candidate using stdin plus a Bash loader passes 20 bounded local cases. The original method reproduces Linux errno7 on a large synthetic script; the candidate delivers the payload exactly with a maximum 92-byte argument. Quoting, UTF-8, stdin EOF, exit/trap behavior and timeout cases were checked.

The loader reads the complete script before executing it and closes command stdin, avoiding the bash -s hazard where read/cat can consume later script lines. Original and candidate use the pinned _run implementation. The comparison took 0.83 seconds, peak RSS 28,912 KiB, with temporary paths removed. No live pipeline was modified.

Next: exercise actual Docker behavior and owned-process cleanup, then a predeclared live PR comparison. These results use a local Docker-argument adapter, not a Docker daemon or biological task. No recovery count is claimed; shell diagnostic/introspection differences and inherited remote timeout cleanup remain explicit.

[Evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/726307f44ecef02e41b4e85d1622549224c8b28d/experiments/30-script-transport/local-results.json) · [Scope](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/726307f44ecef02e41b4e85d1622549224c8b28d/experiments/30-script-transport/issue-scope.md) · [Logbook](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/726307f44ecef02e41b4e85d1622549224c8b28d/experiments/30-script-transport/logbook.md). All changes remain research-only; no promotion to main, live task repair or model spend. The issue remains open.

🤖 Real Docker mechanism checks are complete; live repository comparisons remain outstanding.

Two initial infrastructure attempts failed before creating containers (missing Docker CLI, then an uncached mutable image tag). The subsequent two probes used the pinned Docker CLI and immutable image from the original experiment. Both reproduce upstream `E2BIG` and exact delivery of the 1,080,000-byte payload by the candidate. All attempts and adaptations are retained separately.

The fourth probe distinguishes runnable processes from zombie entries: after client timeout, baseline Bash CPU ticks increased 36→67 and candidate ticks 36→71. Both share the original timeout implementation. This is a separate inherited cancellation problem; it does not demonstrate that the old repository failures were caused by leftover processes. A transport comparison must isolate and remove owned sandboxes between arms to avoid contamination.

All four jobs are terminal with one attempt each, 0.05441778 allocated CPU-hours total, zero model calls and no new capacity. Every created container was removed and absence verified; downloaded tool files were removed. The shared immutable input-image cache remains. No biological PR or task has yet been recovered by this candidate.

[Findings](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/39048b92429f437127db14ec69de6731ef310c3e/experiments/30-script-transport/findings.md), [precise timeout/delivery result](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/39048b92429f437127db14ec69de6731ef310c3e/experiments/30-script-transport/attempts/004/result.json), [all-attempt accounting](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/39048b92429f437127db14ec69de6731ef310c3e/experiments/30-script-transport/probe-accounting.json), [candidate patch](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/39048b92429f437127db14ec69de6731ef310c3e/experiments/30-script-transport/transport.patch).

🤖 Frozen the biological transport comparison to Matchms PR958 (first retained errno7 case by batch order) and PR671 (previous successful control). Unchanged upstream split/targeting/stage functions produce a 425,528-byte post-fix script for PR958; PR671 stages are under 7KB. These are reconstructions from pinned base/head diffs, not retained original failed script bytes.

The driver imports the complete pinned validator and parser dispatcher unchanged. It verifies hashes, records calls, isolates each arm on the same image, and aborts/removes an arm after client timeout to prevent overlapping remote commands. Three offline orchestration checks pass: complete pair, timeout preventing the post stage, and post-stage errno7. No biological recovery or live cleanup claim yet; no new remote job or model call was launched.

[Input manifest](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/09b82ac4/experiments/30-script-transport/live-script-manifest.json) · [Driver checks](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/09b82ac4/experiments/30-script-transport/live-driver-check.json) · [Execution protocol](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/09b82ac4/experiments/30-script-transport/protocol.md). Next: bounded recipe reconstruction and paired execution, preserving raw Matchms evidence privately.

🤖 Completed the frozen live comparison on one reconstructed image. Original transport reproduces errno7 for Matchms PR958; stdin transport delivers both stages. PR671 preserves the exact F2P/P2P sets (1/30), with pre 1 failed/30 passed and post 31 passed under both transports.

PR958 is still invalid: targeting includes two deleted test files, causing pytest to report a missing path and collect zero tests. The outer stage exits 0 despite that pytest error. This is recorded for #32; the completed comparison was not repaired or rerun.

The job used 0.2007278 allocated CPU-hours, bringing all #30 attempts to 0.2551456. Verified the 13,874-byte archive, call-stream hashes and complete owned-resource cleanup. Zero model calls, no new task exports or independent Harbor controls.

The bounded transport comparison has a qualified positive mechanism result. This issue remains open for user review. Production integration, general shell equivalence and cancellation correctness are not claimed. [Evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4862b97e/experiments/30-script-transport/live-diagnosis.json) and [archive readback](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/4862b97e/experiments/30-script-transport/live-readback.json).
